manifest.name: dsh-next-step
manifest.description: Inline next-message predictions and one-click prompt improvement for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: node --check index.js && node --check engine.js && node --check optimizer.js && node --check client.js

readme.text:
**Find your next step. Refine your prompt.**

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Download](https://github.com/Tieboyh/dsh-next-step/releases/latest) · [English video](media/en/promo-en.mp4) · [中文视频](media/zh/promo-zh.mp4)

A community plugin for **DeepSeek Harness desktop and web**. After a reply finishes, a suggested next message appears in gray inside the composer. Press **Tab** to turn it into an editable draft. Have a draft already? Click the magic-wand icon to refine it, then review and send when ready.
[](https://github.com/Tieboyh/dsh-next-step/releases/download/v0.3.0/promo-en.mp4)

- **Inline suggestions:** same composer, same font, no extra suggestion panel.
- **One-click prompt improvement:** write a draft, then click the magic-wand icon to turn it into a well-described, actionable spec. Explicit requirements stay intact; routine gaps receive reasonable **Proposed defaults** so work can begin with minimal questions. Review and edit before sending.
- **Tab to accept:** the prediction becomes a normal draft. It does not send itself.
- **Esc to dismiss:** keep writing your own message.
- **Your draft comes first:** typing, attachments, queued messages, and a new turn hide the prediction.
- **Plugin-controlled:** predictions are active whenever the plugin is enabled. To turn them off, disable the plugin in DSH’s plugin manager.
- **Existing model setup:** uses DSH's configured provider and credentials. No separate API key to enter.

| Prediction text detail | Accepted text detail |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

The improvement screen comes from v0.3.0 verification. Prediction text details are crops of an earlier demo; the old toggle is excluded. [Media sources](docs/MEDIA.md) · [All assets](media/)

No build step or runtime npm dependencies are required.

1. Download the [source archive](https://github.com/Tieboyh/dsh-next-step/archive/refs/tags/v0.5.2.zip) and extract it.
2. Add the extracted plugin directory in DSH’s **Plugin Manager**.
3. Enable **dsh-next-step** there. Use the same manager to disable it.

Both features follow the plugin state, with no separate composer toggle. Reload an updated local installation through Plugin Manager; no separate startup entry point is needed.

The optimizer turns a brief into a compact, executable spec: goals, requirements, a default approach, behavior, and observable acceptance checks. It may add proportionate, low-risk defaults for ordinary gaps, labeled **Proposed defaults** so they remain easy to adjust. It preserves explicit exclusions and does not expand a small task into an unrelated product.

For a vague website request, it can propose a first-version page structure, visual direction, responsive behavior, and implementation approach instead of returning a questionnaire. Existing project conventions take priority. Missing real names, content, or data use labeled placeholders, not fabricated facts.

The optimizer does not request a confirmation section. Missing sensitive values use placeholders and safe execution constraints; routine gaps use proposed defaults. If a returned spec still has a recognized confirmation-section heading, it receives one repair request using the original draft. A second such result is rejected without replacing the draft. Both attempts share the existing timeout. Complete, simple requests stay concise.

The button displays a working label while a request is pending. Successful edits appear directly in the composer without a success banner. Unchanged output still reports that the model suggested no changes and leaves the draft revision untouched.

Click the magic-wand icon beside the composer controls. The request uses your configured model and sends only the current draft. The result replaces the draft without sending it. If you edit, send, switch sessions, or disable the plugin while a request is pending, its result cannot overwrite your new text. Errors preserve the original draft.

Failures explain whether the cause is a timeout, missing model, authentication, exhausted quota, rate limiting, network/service errors, or invalid/truncated output. DSH terminal stream failures keep their original error category. Only safe error categories and HTTP status codes are displayed; provider response bodies and credentials are never forwarded. Cancelling by editing or switching sessions stays silent. Service errors are not automatically retried. A recognized confirmation section can trigger one additional model request to repair the spec, using the same configured service and shared timeout.

The icon is disabled for empty drafts, drafts over 12,000 characters, active turns, and drafts containing structured file/session reference chips. Separate attachments are retained. Each click makes an additional model request and uses the service’s normal quota or billing.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Accept the visible prediction as a draft |
| Esc | Dismiss the current prediction |
| Shift + Tab | Keep normal keyboard focus navigation |

Predictions appear only when the session is idle and the draft, attachment list, and message queue are empty. IME composition does not trigger acceptance. Gray text is a display layer; it is not inserted into the editor document until accepted.
Generating a prediction makes an **additional request to your configured model service** and consumes that service's normal quota or billing. This plugin does not make inference local or free.

The request contains up to 10 recent user/assistant text messages, capped at 12,000 characters. Reasoning blocks, tool results, and attachments are excluded. Predictions and the auxiliary prompt are not appended to the conversation transcript. Results are cached per completed turn in host memory; a restart clears the cache. Errors, timeouts, and unsuitable results leave the composer unchanged.

By default, the plugin reuses the current session's provider and model, with the model's default reasoning configuration. To choose another already-configured route, add this entry to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: next-step
  config:
    timeoutMs: 25000
    # provider: your-configured-provider-id
Set `provider` and `model` together. Timeout range: 1–60 seconds. Output cap: 512 tokens; accepted suggestions: at most 280 characters. No tools or agent actions run during prediction.

Verified with **macOS DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.2**. The media demo uses the matching DSH web runtime. Other versions may change plugin APIs.

```sh
npm run build  # JavaScript syntax checks
npm test       # behavior tests
npm pack
```

- `index.js`: authenticated Connection Fetch RPC, shared by desktop IPC and web HTTP.
- `engine.js`: context selection, model call, deduplication, and invalidation.
- `client.js`: native DSH client module, composer ghost text, and prompt-improvement icon.
- `optimizer.js`: draft-only rewriting, cancellation, and output validation.

The screenshots and videos use the **actual DSH frontend and this plugin**, with a scripted demo provider and synthetic conversations. They are not evidence of live-model prediction quality. See [media provenance](docs/MEDIA.md).

MIT. Community project; not an official DeepSeek or OpenAI product.

**接上下一步。写清你的指令。**

[English](README.md) · [下载安装包](https://github.com/Tieboyh/dsh-next-step/releases/latest) · [中文宣传视频](media/zh/promo-zh.mp4) · [English video](media/en/promo-en.mp4)

为 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面端和 Web 端**制作的社区插件。回复结束后，下一条消息的建议会以灰字出现在输入框里。按 **Tab** 变成可编辑草稿，再由你决定是否发送。已有草稿时，点击魔法棒图标优化提示词，检查后再发送。

[](https://github.com/Tieboyh/dsh-next-step/releases/download/v0.3.0/promo-zh.mp4)

- **建议就在输入框里**：沿用原生字体和行高，不额外占一块面板。
- **一键优化提示词**：写好草稿后，点击魔法棒图标生成描述清楚、可直接执行的需求规格（spec），保留已知要求，对普通缺失信息补充合理的**默认方案（可调整）**，减少追问；保留明确限制，不自动发送。
- **Tab 接受**：灰字变为普通草稿，不会自动发送。
- **Esc 忽略**：随时写自己的下一条消息。
- **草稿优先**：开始输入、有附件、有排队消息或开启新一轮时，建议隐藏。
- **随插件启用**：输入框没有独立开关。要关闭建议，请在 DSH 插件管理中停用插件。
- **沿用现有模型**：复用 DSH 已配置的模型与凭据，无需另外填写 API Key。

| 灰字文字细节 | Tab 接受后的文字 |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |
优化画面来自 v0.3.0 实际验证；灰字细节为早期演示的文字区域裁切，均不展示旧开关。[素材来源](docs/MEDIA.md) · [更多素材](media/)

无需编译，无运行时 npm 依赖。

1. 下载[源码压缩包](https://github.com/Tieboyh/dsh-next-step/archive/refs/tags/v0.5.2.zip)并解压。
2. 在 DSH **插件管理**中添加解压后的插件目录。
3. 在插件管理中启用 **dsh-next-step**。需要关闭时，在同一处停用插件。

两项功能都随插件启停，输入框没有独立开关。已安装的本地目录可在更新后通过插件管理重新加载；无需从其他入口另行启动。

优化器会把简短想法整理成可直接执行的 spec：目标、需求、默认方案、行为和可观察的验收条件。普通信息缺失时，可以自主补充适度、低风险的默认项，并标注为**默认方案（可调整）**；保留明确要求与排除项，不把小任务扩张成无关的大项目。

例如“开发一个风格极致独特的网站”，可以直接提出首版页面结构、视觉方向、移动端适配和实现方式，而不是返回一串问题。已有项目优先沿用原有技术栈和规范；缺少真实名称、素材或数据时使用明确标注的占位内容，不伪造事实。

不输出“待确认项”；敏感值用占位内容与安全执行约束处理，普通缺口用默认方案补全。如果结果仍出现可识别的待确认章节，会携带原始草稿再整理一次；再次出现则拒绝替换原稿，不会无限重试。两次请求共享原有超时。完整的简单请求仍保持简洁。

请求期间按钮显示“优化中…”。成功后直接更新草稿，不再显示成功提示条。结果相同时仍提示“模型未建议修改，已保留原文”，不会重新写入草稿或改变草稿版本。

点击输入框工具栏的魔法棒图标，即可沿用已配置模型优化提示词。请求只发送当前草稿，结果填回输入框，不自动发送。等待期间输入、发送、切换会话或停用插件，迟到的结果不会覆盖新内容；失败时保留原草稿。

失败时会区分超时、模型未配置、认证失败、额度用尽、限流、网络或服务异常，以及输出截断或格式错误。DSH 流结束事件中的服务错误也会保留其类别。仅显示安全的错误分类与 HTTP 状态码，不转发模型服务的原始响应或凭据。编辑或切换会话导致的取消保持安静，服务错误不自动重试。检测到待确认章节时，可能额外调用一次同一模型整理结果，正常消耗额度。

空草稿、超过 12,000 字符的草稿、会话运行中，以及含结构化文件/会话引用的草稿会禁用图标。独立附件会保留。每次点击都会额外调用模型，正常消耗对应服务的额度。

| 按键 | 功能 |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | 将当前灰字建议填入草稿 |
| Esc | 忽略本次建议 |
| Shift + Tab | 保留原有焦点导航 |

建议只在会话空闲、草稿为空且没有附件或排队消息时出现。中文输入法组合输入期间不会接受建议。灰字只是显示层，按 Tab 前不会写入编辑器文档。

生成建议会**额外调用已配置的模型服务**，按该服务正常计费或消耗额度。安装插件不代表推理在本地运行，也不代表免费。

仅提取最近最多 10 条用户/助手消息的正文，合计不超过 12,000 字符；不提交思考块、工具结果或附件。建议与辅助提示词不写入会话正文。每个已完成回合的结果缓存在宿主内存中，重启后缓存清空。失败、超时或没有合适建议时保持输入框原状。

默认沿用当前会话的 provider 和 model，使用该模型的默认推理设置。需要固定其他已配置的模型时，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 添加：

```yaml
- id: next-step
  config:
    timeoutMs: 25000
    # provider: 已配置的provider-id

`provider` 和 `model` 必须同时指定。超时范围 1–60 秒，默认 25 秒；响应上限 512 tokens，建议最多 280 字符。生成建议时不会调用工具或运行 Agent。

已验证 **macOS 桌面版 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**；演示素材使用相同版本的 Web 运行时。其他版本可能存在插件接口变化。

```sh
npm run build  # JavaScript 语法检查
npm test       # 行为测试
npm pack
```

- `index.js`：受 Connection 认证保护的 Fetch RPC，支持桌面 IPC 与 Web HTTP。
- `engine.js`：上下文筛选、模型请求、去重及失效检查。
- `client.js`：原生客户端模块、灰字建议和提示词优化图标。
- `optimizer.js`：仅针对草稿的改写、取消与输出校验。

宣传截图和视频使用**真实 DSH 前端与本插件**，会话及模型响应为固定演示数据，不代表真实模型的预测质量。详见[素材说明](docs/MEDIA.md)。
